name: magi
description: Three-perspective majority deliberation: three independent reviews of one proposal, resolved by 2/3 majority or unanimity for critical items.

interface.longDescription: Three units review one proposal independently (technical, risk and cost, needs and value) and the result is resolved by 2/3 majority, or unanimity for critical items. Dissent stays on the record.
defaultPrompt: Decide with MAGI: should this PR go into this release?
Use MAGI to review this proposal.
